title: From Inference Engine to Inference Control Plane: Connecting vLLM, llm-d, and the Evolution of Efficient Distributed LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2609.23130v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference is evolving from an engine-local optimization problem into a distributed control problem involving reusable state, phase placement, heterogeneous accelerators, networking, autoscaling, reliability, and service-level objectives. This paper connects that transition across peer-reviewed systems research, open-source implementations, and documented production studies. It treats vLLM and llm-d as complementary layers: model-serving engines optimize execution through mechanisms such as PagedAttention, continuous batching, kernels, quantization, and parallelism, while an inference control plane can optimize where, when, and under what policy execution occurs across a fleet. The contribution is synthesis rather than a new benchmark; all reported performance and deployment results remain attributed to their original sources. translated_title: 从推理引擎到推理控制平面：连接 vLLM、llm-d 与高效分布式 LLM 服务的演进
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）推理正在从一个引擎本地的优化问题演变为一个分布式控制问题，其中涉及可复用状态、阶段放置、异构加速器、网络、自动扩缩容、可靠性以及服务级目标。本文将这一转变与同行评审的系统研究、开源实现以及有记录的生产实践联系起来。论文将 vLLM 和 llm-d 视为互补的层次：模型服务引擎通过 PagedAttention、连续批处理、内核优化、量化和并行等机制优化执行过程，而推理控制平面则可以优化在整个集群中执行发生的位置、时机以及所采用的策略。本文的贡献在于综合梳理，而非提出新的基准测试；所有报告的性能和部署结果仍归属于其原始来源。综合证据表明，现代推理中稀缺的资源正在发生转移……
tldr: 本文综合系统研究、开源实现与生产实践，指出 LLM 推理正从引擎级优化演变为分布式控制问题，并阐明 vLLM 作为模型服务引擎与 llm-d 作为推理控制平面二者互补，共同推动高效分布式 LLM 服务的发展。
en_tdlr: This paper synthesizes peer-reviewed systems research, open-source implementations, and production studies to show that LLM inference is evolving from engine-level optimization into a distributed control problem, positioning vLLM as a model-serving engine and llm-d as an inference control plane that together enable efficient distributed LLM serving.
